title: Mary Lou's singing career
summary: He lists her backup work and tells of first meeting her at a concert with Herman McCoy, Nelson Riddle and June Christy.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Mary Lou has also worked as a backup singer.

Backup singer. She worked with the Cheerleaders. Then she worked with the Herman McCoy Group from UCLA. She worked with Tennessee Ernie Ford Radio Show. Then she worked Dave Garroway's show in New York when it was on TV live, when everything had to be right the first time. So she's had quite a bit of experience.
Did she ever record with Herman? I know Herman recorded a few times.
She may have. When I first met Mary Lou (this is way before anything ever happened between us), she...

...she was...we did a... I think it could have been... Well, anyway, it was a concert with the Herman McCoy Group, Nelson Riddle, Buddy Collette and myself and June Christy were the featured artists on that.
Oh, my mind's clicking. I remember a lot of things. I jump around, but it's all there somewhere.
